summary: Resolved the open necessary gap on the ReadOnlySafe read-index flow. ReadOnly is reassigned only in raft.reset, reached solely from becomeFollower/becomeCandidate/becomeLeader, and the only producer of MsgHeartbeatResp.Context is handleHeartbeat echoing the leader's own value (vote contexts travel on MsgVote); raft.Step drops lower-term messages before dispatch. Since leadership terms strictly increase and heartbeatCtx emits a non-decreasing message total, a live instance coincides with one leadership term and no legal producer can supply an ack position exceeding the admitted request count. This defeats the premise of the earlier suspicion, so the account is corrected: the missing Context validation is a scoped robustness fact (an out-of-contract peer can panic the leader or advance an unjustified read index), not an in-model CFT safety or liveness defect. The investigation is marked explained, the gap answered as resolved, the scoping fact added, and the defect claim refuted while retaining the still-valid code observations, the native-probe results, and an unasserted note about retry accumulation.
